name: AppFlowy
author: AppFlowy-IO
login: Desktop and mobile apps: set the self-hosted cloud URL to this tile's HTTPS origin first.
description: Self-hosted Notion: documents, databases and a wiki on this box. AppFlowy Cloud behind nginx on :8102, loopback-only behind Serve. First admin is seeded from .env and public sign-up is off. AI chat and the full-text search indexer are left out — AI wants an OpenAI key this box does not have, and search mmaps about 2 GB. Desktop and mobile apps point at the same HTTPS URL.

control._comment: Stop order: nginx first, then the app tier, then GoTrue, then MinIO/Redis, then Postgres. Start is the reverse.
